title: Microsoft Dataverse: unlicensed Entra users as activity recipients
summary: The roadmap details, recipient licence exemption, administrator roles and environment setting are supported. The categorical absence of autonomous behaviour and the precise claim about when lookup results appear are not documented; the licensing presentation and missing security-role control row also need minor corrections.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 574121 concerns adding unlicensed users to Microsoft Dataverse activity recipient fields.
claims.quote: "id": 574121, "title": "Microsoft Dataverse: Add users without licenses to activity recipient fields"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Microsoft 365 app, Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Microsoft Dataverse.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft 365 app", "Dynamics 365 Sales", "Dynamics 365 Customer Service", "Microsoft Dataverse"]

claims.claim: The roadmap status is in development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phases are General Availability and Preview.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Active Entra users in the tenant can be activity recipients without a Dataverse or Power Apps licence.
claims.quote: Turn on this feature in the Power Platform admin center to allow users with a Microsoft Entra ID to be added to activity recipient fields without requiring a Dataverse or Power Apps license.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Created unlicensed-user records have disabled status.
claims.quote: The user record is created with a disabled status.

claims.where: licensing.notes; What's changing; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: These unlicensed recipients cannot sign in to or run Dynamics 365 apps.
claims.quote: These users can be included as recipients, but they can't sign in to or run Dynamics 365 apps.

claims.claim: The feature is administrator opt-in.
claims.quote: By default, you can only add users with a Dataverse or Power Apps license to activities in Dynamics 365 apps. Turn on the Activities for users without licenses feature in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents the feature as a preview.
claims.quote: Add users without licenses to activity recipient fields (preview)

claims.claim: Without this feature, only users with a Dataverse or Power Apps licence can be added to Dynamics 365 activities.
claims.quote: By default, you can only add users with a Dataverse or Power Apps license to activities in Dynamics 365 apps.

claims.claim: Email To, Cc and Bcc fields are covered.
claims.quote: such as the To, Cc, or Bcc fields of an email

claims.where: What's changing: recipient examples; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Appointment attendee fields are covered.
claims.quote: Required Attendees, Optional attendees of appointment

claims.claim: Phone call Call From and Call To fields are covered.
claims.quote: Call From, or Call To of phone call.

claims.claim: After enabling the feature, the user lookup uses the Microsoft Entra ID table.
claims.quote: After you enable the Activities for users without licenses feature in the Power Platform admin center, the user lookup uses the Microsoft Entra ID table

claims.claim: The Microsoft Entra ID table is a virtual Dataverse table showing active Entra users.
claims.quote: a virtual Dataverse table that displays the current list of active Microsoft Entra ID users.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Selecting an Entra user for an activity creates a corresponding unlicensed-user record in the environment.
claims.quote: When you select a Microsoft Entra ID user for an activity, Dataverse creates a corresponding unlicensed-user record in the environment so that the user can be added to the activity's recipient fields.

claims.where: What's changing: later licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Later licence assignment automatically updates the user to a licensed user.
claims.quote: When a user without a license is assigned a license, the user is automatically updated to a licensed user and can use the application based on their assigned security roles and permissions.

claims.claim: Earlier activities remain associated with the same user record after licensing.
claims.quote: Activities previously associated with the user remain associated with the same user record. No migration or conversion of the user or their existing activities is required.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: All tenant users must receive read permission on the Microsoft Entra ID table before the feature is enabled.
claims.quote: Before you turn on the feature in the Power Platform admin center, you need to grant all users in the tenant read permission on the Microsoft Entra ID table.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: The Entra table exposes basic directory details, including the display name used in the address book.
claims.quote:
DisplayName
Description | The name displayed in the address book for the user.
IsValidForRead | True

claims.claim: The documented prerequisite for granting Entra table read access is Privileged Role Administrator.
claims.quote: You need to be a Privileged Role Administrator in the Microsoft Entra admin center to grant users read access to the Microsoft Entra ID table.

claims.claim: A Power Platform administrator is required to enable the feature in the admin center.
claims.quote: You need to be a Power Platform administrator to turn on the feature in Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: The recipient switch is configured per environment.
claims.quote:
In the Manage pane, select Environments. Then select an environment.
Select Settings.
Select Product, and then select Features.

claims.claim: The admin UI path is Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Activities for users without licenses > Add anyone with an Entra ID to an activity's recipients fields.
claims.quote: Select Manage ... select Environments. Then select an environment. Select Settings. Select Product, and then select Features. Go to Activities for users without licenses. Select the Add anyone with an Entra ID to an activity's recipients fields checkbox.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and notes
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a feature-specific API or automation equivalent for the recipient switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Activities for users without licenses API organization; organization unlicensed activity recipients Entra. Opened feature, aaduser, organization, pac env and list-tenantsettings. Searched organization text for unlicensed, activity recipient, activities license and Entra.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a tenant-wide default control for this feature on either the admin UI or API surface.
claims.quote: Searched: unlicensed activity tenant default Power Platform admin settings PowerShell. Opened add-unlicensed-users-activities, tenant-settings and list-tenantsettings; read PowerShell support search excerpt. None documents a tenant-wide recipient-feature default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Overall feature licensing is not yet published, represented by the unknown licensing model.
claims.quote: Qualifying Dynamics 365 licenses include Power Apps and Power Automate use rights for extending and customizing the licensed Dynamics 365 application. These rights must be used in the context of the licensed Dynamics 365 application.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace 'Overall licensing for the feature is not yet published.' in the notes and rationale with 'Existing Dynamics 365 app licensing still applies to app users; recipients need no Dataverse or Power Apps licence. No feature-specific licence is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/pricing-billing-skus and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-entity-licenses.

claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no charge specific to this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse add unlicensed users activities licensing pricing; Activities for users without licenses autonomous price. Opened add-unlicensed-users-activities and pricing-billing-skus; read License requirements for tables excerpts.

claims.claim: Read permission can be provided by updating existing security roles assigned to users.
claims.quote: Update each existing security role assigned to users and add read permission for the Microsoft Entra ID table.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; At rollout
claims.claim: Read permission can instead be provided through a custom security role assigned to all users.
claims.quote: Create a custom security role that grants read permission for the Microsoft Entra ID table, and then assign the role to all users.

claims.claim: There is no autonomous behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse add unlicensed users activities licensing pricing tenant default API organization settings pac env update-settings autonomous; Activities for users without licenses autonomous price. Opened add-unlicensed-users-activities; no categorical absence of autonomous behaviour is stated.
claims.fix: Replace 'No autonomous behaviour.' with 'Dataverse creates a corresponding unlicensed-user record when someone selects a Microsoft Entra ID user for an activity.'

claims.claim: pac env update-settings is documented for updating organization settings generally.
claims.quote: The pac env list-settings command returns all the columns from the first and only row of the organization entity type. Use pac env update-settings to change those settings.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every configuration control in the governance checklist is represented in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'update existing roles or create a custom role with read on the Entra ID table'; 'Assign the read role to all users'. Table: recipient switch and undocumented tenant-wide default only.
claims.fix: The checklist's Entra table read-permission configuration has no corresponding controls-table row. Record this coverage gap; do not add a row as part of this correction.

claims.claim: The recipient lookup returns results only after users receive Entra table read permission through a security role.
claims.quote: Searched: organization unlicensed activity recipients Entra. Opened add-unlicensed-users-activities and aaduser. Read permission is required before enabling the feature; the exact lookup-results behaviour is not stated.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence with 'Before turning on the feature, grant all users in the tenant read permission on the Microsoft Entra ID table through existing security roles or a custom security role.'
